def edges(chart, cell, bearing):
    """Every single-decision move out of one pose, as `((action, granularity), pose)`.

    FOUR FAMILIES, EACH EXACTLY ONE PRESS, and the order they are yielded in is the tie-break the
    search inherits: translations before turns and the LONGEST stride first, so a route that can
    travel does. A stride costs one decision whether it carries one cell or three, and spending it
    on three is free.

      * `move_forward` of 3, 2 or 1 cells, out of a pose no translation has already been refused in.
        A stride may LAND on ground a flank band merely glimpsed, but it may not continue THROUGH
        it: striding over cells nothing has looked along is the most expensive habit this search can
        have, worth more than the reversal it rations.
      * `move_backward`, same lengths, over RAY-PROVEN ground only. Admitting the reversal makes the
        cell behind cost one decision where turning around and walking costs three; restricting it
        to proven ground is what stops the planner backing blind into a cell it has only glimpsed.
      * the two turns, always available, one quarter-turn each.
    """
    for back in (False, True):
        if chart.refuted(cell, (bearing + 2) % 4 if back else bearing):
            continue
        name = "move_backward" if back else "move_forward"
        run = []
        for cells in (1, 2, 3):
            step = A.advance(cell, bearing, cells, back)
            if not (chart.verified(step) if back else chart.enterable(step)):
                break
            run.append((cells, step))
            if not chart.verified(step):
                break
        for cells, step in reversed(run):
            yield (name, A.granularity_for(cells)), (step, bearing)
    for turn in ("turn_right", "turn_left"):
        yield (turn, "small"), (cell, A.heading_after(bearing, turn))

async def decide(evaluator, frame_data):
    """One decision step -> engine Action: delegate to the frozen model, then audit its geometry.

    The decision still comes from the evaluator's pristine VLM step + JSON parser, so the model sees
    exactly the baseline conversation and `baseline_step` is called once per step. The returned
    `Action` is a mutable dataclass whose `key` is the entire override surface — the engine presses
    only that — so a vetoed pick is rewritten in place while the metadata keeps both the action the
    model named and the reason it was replaced.
    """
    step = getattr(evaluator, "baseline_step", None) or evaluator.openai_ai_model
    act = await step(frame_data)
    if not _LEDGER:
        _LEDGER.update(_FRESH_LEDGER())
    head, heading, body = _LEDGER["head"], _LEDGER["heading"], _BODY(_LEDGER)
    ahead = {name: _ONWARD(head, v) for name, v in _STEP.items()}
    inbox = [n for n, c in ahead.items() if _INSIDE(c) and not _FLIPS(_STEP[n], heading)]
    legal = [n for n in inbox if ahead[n] not in body]
    roomy = []
    for name in legal:
        onward = [m for m, w in _STEP.items()
                  if not _FLIPS(w, _STEP[name]) and _INSIDE(_ONWARD(ahead[name], w))
                  and _ONWARD(ahead[name], w) not in body]
        if onward:
            roomy.append(name)
    options = roomy or legal or inbox
    wanted = _WANTED(act)
    shipped = wanted if wanted in options else _FRESHEST(_LEDGER, options, ahead)
    if shipped != wanted:
        act.key = _PRESS[shipped]
        act.metadata = _AUDITED(act, shipped, wanted, head)
        _VETOED(_LEDGER)
    _ADVANCE(_LEDGER, shipped, ahead)
    return act

def think(book):
    """Choose this turn's request and the choice set the agent is shown.

    Three phases in strict order. SOLVE once a configuration is proved — the request is the first
    move of the shortest word home and the menu is every move that shortens it. SURVEY while the
    configuration is still ambiguous — the request is the next closing camera turn. SWEEP only if
    perception never resolves, so the harness still spends its steps on the configurations nearest
    the start rather than standing still.
    """
    if book["state"] is None:
        if len(book["live"]) == 1:
            adopt(book, book["live"][0])
        else:
            whole = assemble(book["readings"])
            if whole is not None:
                adopt(book, whole)
    if book["state"] is not None:
        word = solve_word(book["state"])
        if word:
            book["phase"] = "solve"
            book["plan"] = word
            book["menu"] = menu_of(book["state"]) or [MOVE_NAMES[word[0]]]
            book["want"] = MOVE_NAMES[word[0]]
            return book
        restart_survey(book)
    if book["route"] and TRUSTED:
        book["phase"] = "survey"
        book["plan"] = ()
        book["want"] = book["route"][0]
        book["menu"] = [book["want"]]
        return book
    book["phase"] = "sweep"
    book["plan"] = ()
    book["want"] = SWEEP_CYCLE[book["sweeps"] % len(SWEEP_CYCLE)]
